newsitem.title: SPAIN: Uralita 1996 attrib profit 2.21 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Uralita 1996 attrib profit 2.21 bln ptas.

text.p: Spanish building materials firm Uralita SA reported on Monday a sharp drop in its 1996 attributable profit which fell to 2.21 billion pesetas from 6.02 billion in 1995.

"The fall in profits is mainly due to a general weakness in the construction industry and a low level of PVC prices (28 percent lower than the previous year) that have negatively affected our chemicals division as well as our pipe business," the company said in a statement.
Consolidated group sales fell four percent to 135.14 billion pesetas.
The company said difficulties at its Unidad de Sanitarios unit whose losses grew by one billion pesetas in 1996, and the close of its assembly business had also added to 1996 losses.
However, Uralita said the outlook for 1997 was more favourable as PVC prices had already begun to recover.
A better performance in its sanitary business and the positive effect of investments realised in 1996 would also boost 1997 results, it said.
